Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry component of this study (PXD044767) specifically uses chemical cross-linking (DSSO) to validate the structural model of the Myo6 off-state. The primary biological comparison driving the MS analysis is the conformational state (compact/off-state vs elongated/on-state) of the protein, which is modulated by the presence or absence of nucleotides (ADP.Pi). While the paper describes many other perturbations (mutations, partners), the MS data provided in the PRIDE record is focused on the structural validation of the purified full-length protein.
